verdict.rationale: Gram documents tool-call logs across hosted/tunneled/shadow servers and local tools, and the GitHub repo description explicitly claims usage tracking across teams by tokens/cost, budgets, and tool effectiveness measurement, directly matching call volumes/cost/usage. Errors are implied via raw execution logs but not explicitly broken out as an error-rate metric, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of the analytics dashboard itself. Missing for 10: explicit error-rate reporting UI evidence, independent third-party validation of the analytics dashboard beyond vendor docs/GitHub description.
